summary: First test run for Nomyra Travels. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass (public content, enquiries, auth, admin CRUD, SEO). Frontend: all headline flows verified — hero + CTAs, sticky nav (7 links + Call + Plan Trip), Trip Builder chips correctly pre-populate the enquiry dialog (destination, style, days, experiences chips, message), enquiry submission returns success state with wa.me link and Call button (whatsapp_notified=false as expected), admin login (bad password shows error, real login redirects to /admin, all 7 tabs render, submitted enquiries visible), /admin without token redirects to /admin/login, mobile viewport shows hamburger + mobile menu + floating call/WhatsApp with no horizontal scroll, gallery/blog filters and 12 blog posts (1 lead + 11 cards) render, sitemap.xml + robots.txt served. NOTE: on first load ALL tel:/mailto:/wa.me links were empty because REACT_APP_BUSINESS_* env vars weren't in the running frontend bundle — fixed by restarting the frontend service (env change requires restart on CRA).

integration_issues.issue: Before frontend restart, telHref rendered as 'tel:' and wa.me links had no phone number because CRA had not picked up REACT_APP_BUSINESS_PHONE/WHATSAPP/EMAIL from frontend/.env. After 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' the links populate correctly (tel:+917002492612, wa.me/917002492612, mailto:nomadaccidental@gmail.com). Main agent should ensure the deployed build always includes these env vars.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider a runtime settings fetch on the frontend so contact links don't require a rebuild/restart when env vars change (currently they come from build-time REACT_APP_*).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=False despite cookies being set on login — cookie-based auth from the frontend will not work cross-origin; the admin frontend already uses Bearer tokens from localStorage so this is fine, but the httpOnly cookies are effectively dead code for the browser flow.
server.py: seed_admin only updates password if it differs; does not update other admin fields — acceptable for now.

TripBuilder testids are slugified (builder-destination-meghalaya, builder-style-adventure, builder-duration-6-8-days). The review request used pattern wildcards, but note the exact chip values in the problem statement (Meghalaya, Adventure, 6–8 Days) map to lowercased slug testids.
EnquiryForm exposes travel style select as data-testid='enquiry-style' (not 'enquiry-travel-style'). Minor inconsistency vs prefill key name.
test_credentials: Admin: nomadaccidental@gmail.com / Qwerty@1998 (used; verified successful login).
seed_data_creation: Only test enquiries were created and deleted during backend tests. Two enquiries created via frontend Playwright are left in the DB (Playwright Test / Test User) — main agent may delete via admin UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical endpoints incl. auth (1 bad-pw attempt only to avoid lockout), enquiries create+admin list+patch+delete, and gallery CRUD. Frontend env vars require 'supervisorctl restart frontend' after any change to /app/frontend/.env. Trip Builder chip testids are slugified lowercase. Blog page uses 1 'lead' post + N-1 'card' posts, so blog-card count = total-1.
rca of the issue: Empty tel:/mailto:/wa.me links RCA: React scripts (CRA/craco) embed REACT_APP_* at compile time. The initial dev server process was started before the current /app/frontend/.env values were in place (or an env-less build was cached). Since the values are protected variables, restarting the frontend supervisor process re-read /app/frontend/.env and re-injected them, immediately populating SITE.phone/whatsapp/email and all telHref/waHref usages. Mitigation: main agent may want to add a small runtime GET /api/settings hydration for these fields so they can be edited from admin without redeploy.
